question.worked_solution:
We proceed to factor the left side by grouping:

$$
\begin{aligned}36{d}^{3}-81{d}^{2}-16d+36 & = \\ (36{d}^{3}-81{d}^{2})-(16d-36) & = \\ 9{d}^{2}(4d-9)-4(4d-9) & = \\ (4d-9)\cdot 9{d}^{2}-(4d-9)\cdot 4 & = \\ (4d-9)(9{d}^{2}-4) & \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we solve $(4d-9)(9{d}^{2}-4)=0$ by setting each factor equal to $0.$

- Setting the factor $(4d-9)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}4d-9 & =0 \\ 4d & =9 \\ d & =\frac{9}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

- Setting the factor $(9{d}^{2}-4)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}9{d}^{2}-4 & =0 \\ 9{d}^{2} & =4 \\ {d}^{2} & =\frac{4}{9} \\ d & =\pm \frac{2}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $d=\frac{9}{4},\,\pm \frac{2}{3}.$
